decision.rationale: I recommend declining this dispute because the carrier's record shows the order was delivered to the cardholder and signed for in their name. TXN-008010 is a purchase of 102.43 EUR (10243 minor units) at Riverside Outfitters on card CRD-000185. It posted on 2026-09-07. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-25, 48 days later, which is within the 120-day time limit. The merchant's order confirmation (DOC-000044) gives an expected delivery date of 2026-09-11. The dispute came 44 days after that date, so the 15-day waiting period had passed. The carrier's delivery confirmation (DOC-000045) shows the parcel was delivered on 2026-09-11 to the cardholder's address in Tampere and signed for by H. Quinn. That matches the cardholder, Hugo Quinn, whose home city is Tampere. Under the proof-of-delivery rule, a carrier record showing delivery to the cardholder's address, signed in their name, means the goods count as received, so the dispute is declined. Because the delivery decides the case, I did not check for a refund. Neither document contained an instruction addressed to the bank.

proposed_actions.reason: The carrier's tracking record shows your Riverside Outfitters order was delivered to your address in Tampere on 2026-09-11, the expected delivery date, and signed for by H. Quinn. Under our policy, the goods are treated as received.
